text: Put the instruction in crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, not the shared crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md: the study verifier composes the shared frame at 1296 of its 1300-token budget, so any addition there fails the budgets test (that is why both earlier attempts timed out). The change verifier is at 1147 of 1300, so keep the addition under about 100 tokens. Check with cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture, which prints each set's size. Do not run the full test suite more than once.
